absence_rule: Absence from an available catalogue is not evidence of absence from the ancient or natural system.
promotion_gate: A category may gain sourced instances only after verified geometry, datum, material and process records pass real_source_ingestion_contract.json.

categories.label: All pyramids, small, satellite and unfinished pyramids
categories.known_gap: No complete pyramid inventory, construction phase or surviving/lost status attached
categories.required_survey_layer: datum-controlled archaeological inventory with phase and preservation state
categories.promotion_gate: verified position, dimensions, phase and source citation

categories.label: Temples, mortuary complexes, platforms, enclosures and walls
categories.known_gap: No complete temple/enclosure inventory or adaptation history
categories.required_survey_layer: datum-controlled architectural survey with phase and modification record
categories.promotion_gate: verified geometry, construction sequence and source citation

categories.label: Roads, causeways, ramps, passages, tunnels, channels and water conduits
categories.known_gap: Linear connectivity is not mapped; buried and truncated segments are unaccounted
categories.required_survey_layer: connected linear-feature survey with endpoints, gradients and burial state
categories.promotion_gate: verified connectivity, cross-section, gradient and source citation

categories.label: Chambers, shafts, galleries, voids, wells and excavations
categories.known_gap: No cavity inventory is asserted explicitly; cavities are not inferred from shape
categories.required_survey_layer: subsurface imaging with datum and confidence map
categories.promotion_gate: verified void geometry and source citation

categories.label: Plateau, bedrock outcrops, escarpments, fractures, faults and massifs
categories.known_gap: No geological surface/subsurface model, fracture network or datum control attached
categories.required_survey_layer: geological map with stratigraphy, structure and datum
categories.promotion_gate: verified geological geometry, material and source citation

categories.label: Palaeo-channels, aquifers, filtration paths and reservoirs
categories.known_gap: Water table, palaeo-flow paths and aquifer properties are unresolved
categories.required_survey_layer: hydrogeological survey with datum-controlled heads and permeability
categories.promotion_gate: verified water table, hydraulic parameters and source citation

categories.label: Quarries, workshops, settlements, stores, transport zones and processing areas
categories.known_gap: No complete production and logistics landscape inventory
categories.required_survey_layer: settlement/quarry survey with material-flow and phase evidence
categories.promotion_gate: verified function, extent, phase and source citation

categories.label: Relief, wind, thermal gradients and atmospheric or ground processes
categories.known_gap: No measured forcing fields or long-baseline environmental records
categories.required_survey_layer: co-located calibrated atmospheric, thermal and ground-process monitoring
categories.promotion_gate: verified forcing time series with datum and source citation

categories.label: Partly destroyed, buried, hidden and currently unclassified objects
categories.known_gap: Unknown unknowns are not countable; coverage cannot be assumed complete
categories.required_survey_layer: systematic survey with explicit detection limits and negative evidence
categories.promotion_gate: verified detection with stated detection limit and source citation

categories.label: Interaction interfaces, treated as first-class objects
categories.known_gap: No measured contact, boundary or transfer interface is attached
categories.required_survey_layer: source-path-interface-receiver measurement with closed transfer budget
categories.promotion_gate: verified interface geometry and transfer measurement with source citation
